data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## What
Write failing tests for: (a) AcliClient.unassign_issue wire format verification, (b) handle_create_event integration with BRIDGE_USER_MAP match and no-match paths.

## Acceptance Criteria

### Part A — AcliClient.unassign_issue unit test
- Import: from acli_integration import AcliClient (via load_module_from_path)
- Mock urllib.request.urlopen to capture the PUT request
- Assert: request method == PUT
- Assert: request URL ends with /rest/api/3/issue/{jira_key}/assignee
- Assert: request body == json.dumps({"accountId": null}) — NOT wrapped in {"value": ...}
- Test name: test_unassign_issue_wire_format

### Part B — handle_create_event integration: match path
- Mock acli_client with a create_issue that returns {"key": "PROJ-1"} and unassign_issue that does nothing
- Set BRIDGE_USER_MAP = {"joe@example.com": "accountId-abc"} in os.environ
- CREATE event with assignee = "joe@example.com"
- Assert: create_issue was called with a ticket_data where accountId-abc appears as assignee
- Assert: unassign_issue was NOT called
- Test name: test_handle_create_event_user_map_match

### Part C — handle_create_event integration: no-match path
- CREATE event with assignee = "unknown@example.com" (not in BRIDGE_USER_MAP)
- Assert: create_issue called without assignee (or with None/empty assignee)
- Assert: unassign_issue called with the jira_key from create_issue result
- Assert: a BRIDGE_ALERT event file is written with reason containing "no BRIDGE_USER_MAP entry for unknown@example.com"
- Test name: test_handle_create_event_user_map_no_match

- All tests must fail RED before implementation

## Files to Modify
- tests/scripts/test_bridge_outbound.py
data.title: RED: unit test AcliClient.unassign_issue wire format + integration test handle_create_event user-map paths
